purpose: Activate exactly one exclusive People main V60 authoring lease for HRM-012 after current-base owner correction, semantic correction and clean worktree materialization. The lease grants migration authority only when combined with the matching executable module start token.

allowed: Create exactly ppl_workforce_ingestion_runs and ppl_workforce_ingestion_items with the keys, indexes, lifecycle guards, ENABLE/FORCE RLS and tenant predicates sealed by the owner and semantic authorities.
Reuse without recreation int_connector_instances, int_mapping_profiles, int_connector_cursors, ppl_command_receipts, sys_people_audit_events and sys_people_outbox_events.
Add VALIDATED to the closed item outcome set and enforce VALIDATE_ONLY source = derived validated items + rejected + duplicate with accepted/applied/quarantined all zero.
For APPLY forbid VALIDATED and enforce source = accepted + rejected + duplicate and accepted = applied + quarantined_after_acceptance.

Any second People migration or path other than the exact V60 path
Any third HRM-012 table or validated_count aggregate column
Any recreation of connector, mapping, cursor, receipt, audit or outbox stores
Any caller-supplied identity, context, scope or revision persistence
Any placeholder, sentinel or invented authorization revision
Any seed, backfill, deletion, automatic privilege elevation, tenant enrollment or production execution

static: V60 is unique and the exact leased path is the only new People migration.
V1 through V59 bytes remain unchanged.
Exactly two tables are created and the six existing stores are not recreated.
Mode-specific VALIDATE_ONLY and APPLY outcomes and equations match semantic successor v2.
database: real PostgreSQL clean People migration through V60

VALIDATE_ONLY VALIDATED/rejected/duplicate accounting and zero accepted/applied/quarantined counts
APPLY two-equation conservation and VALIDATED rejection
immutable identity, source, mapping, outcome and linked-replay guards
